objects: one current battlefield permanent with a source-pinned fixed-mana Echo descriptor
costs: fixed generic, colored, and colorless mana including a zero cost
timing: the intervening condition is checked when the upkeep event occurs and again as the trigger resolves
choices: the frozen trigger controller chooses whether to pay when payment is currently possible
hidden_information: the choice contains only public source and cost information and is projected only to its chooser
apnap: simultaneous Echo triggers use the ordinary APNAP/controller-order trigger batch
replacement_effects: the represented fixed mana payment and sacrifice use their existing canonical typed owners
copy: copied or granted Echo requires separately trusted typed ability-fragment propagation
control_change: the trigger preserves the acquisition controller and timestamp captured at trigger creation; a later controller does not become the trigger controller
zone_change: a source that leaves and returns is a new logical object and cannot satisfy the old trigger's intervening condition
source_leaves: a departed source makes the intervening condition false before any payment or sacrifice choice is issued

variants: control acquired after the prior upkeep
control acquired before the prior upkeep

implementation.component: quorune.control_history, quorune.echo, quorune.compiler.echo_nodes, trigger discovery, and the shared optional pay-or-sacrifice handler
implementation.supported_slice: Printed ordinary Echo whose complete cost is fixed generic, colored, or colorless mana, including zero.

known_blockers: hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, variable, alternative, and nonmana Echo costs remain outside the closed grammar
cost modification and restricted-mana interactions remain bounded by the canonical payment subsystem's current coverage
granted, copied, face-down, and merged-object Echo need trusted typed ability propagation
aggregate triggered-ability, control-history, cost-payment, and sacrifice coverage remains incomplete
